### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/plugin-security`, touching **6** documentable anchor(s).

**11** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`  _(via sys_permission_set (literal, a string literal in slots))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/objects.mdx`  _(via SysUserPermissionSet (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx`  _(via sys_permission_set (literal, a string literal in slots), sys_position (literal, a string literal in slots))_
- `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`  _(via permission_set (literal, a string literal in a comment in slots; a string literal in slots))_
- `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx`  _(via sys_permission_set (literal, a string literal in slots), sys_position (literal, a string literal in slots))_
- `content/docs/permissions/delegated-administration.mdx`  _(via sys_permission_set (literal, a string literal in slots), sys_position (literal, a string literal in slots))_
- `content/docs/permissions/explain.mdx`  _(via permission_set (literal, a string literal in a comment in slots; a string literal in slots))_
- `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx`  _(via permission_set (literal, a string literal in a comment in slots; a string literal in slots), sys_permission_set (literal, a string literal in slots))_
- `content/docs/permissions/positions.mdx`  _(via sys_position (literal, a string literal in slots))_
- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`  _(via permission_set (literal, a string literal in a comment in slots; a string literal in slots), sys_permission_set (literal, a string literal in slots), sys_position (literal, a string literal in slots))_
- `content/docs/protocol/backward-compatibility.mdx`  _(via sys_position (literal, a string literal in slots))_

⛔ **10** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/index.mdx`  _(via sys_position (literal, a string literal in slots))_
- `content/docs/releases/v12.mdx`  _(via sys_permission_set (literal, a string literal in slots))_
- `content/docs/releases/v13.mdx`  _(via SysUserPosition (symbol, a top-level const object), sys_permission_set (literal, a string literal in slots), sys_position (literal, a string literal in slots))_
- `content/docs/releases/v14.mdx`  _(via sys_position (literal, a string literal in slots))_
- `content/docs/releases/v15.mdx`  _(via sys_permission_set (literal, a string literal in slots), sys_position (literal, a string literal in slots))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via sys_permission_set (literal, a string literal in slots))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via sys_permission_set (literal, a string literal in slots), sys_position (literal, a string literal in slots))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-2.mdx`  _(via sys_position (literal, a string literal in slots))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx`  _(via sys_permission_set (literal, a string literal in slots))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`  _(via sys_permission_set (literal, a string literal in slots))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **41** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 51b43a8dc45fef9d86229509ab6b2679ffa9d501` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `c6d4c0b294bba6e9748fc057aa9341c1ca3f46dc` — the merge of head `7de0f00c91aaaecd2d70ba59695d373baa290bf1` into base `51b43a8dc45fef9d86229509ab6b2679ffa9d501`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin c6d4c0b294bba6e9748fc057aa9341c1ca3f46dc && git checkout c6d4c0b294bba6e9748fc057aa9341c1ca3f46dc
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 51b43a8dc45fef9d86229509ab6b2679ffa9d501 7de0f00c91aaaecd2d70ba59695d373baa290bf1 && git checkout -B drift-repro 51b43a8dc45fef9d86229509ab6b2679ffa9d501 && git merge --no-ff 7de0f00c91aaaecd2d70ba59695d373baa290bf1

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 51b43a8dc45fef9d86229509ab6b2679ffa9d501
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 51b43a8dc45fef9d86229509ab6b2679ffa9d501` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Seat ACCEPT: #22939 (#22865 B2 phase 2: grant name pickers on the user page) at `7de0f00c91`; queued on green

Epic PM `session_01Rerax7QTjKMPCUZxQUtPFR` (`marchtian`), seat `epic:#15194`, 2026-10-12T05:27Z. Ruling objectstack#22865 → B2 (6115690641). Phase 1 measured in 6116396441. The widget keys were accepted in 6116842485, and the widget is objectui PR-5, merged as `088e0f705` (Landed 6117301706). The developer is `session_013XKtmoR5QCUSTMjiQ3os49`.

**The head's tree equals `d4c22c8fe`** (`git diff d4c22c8fe 7de0f00c91` is empty). The pin commit `e486abb9c8` was folded in and then reverted by a new commit, without force-push. `.objectui-sha` is claimed by #22874, and objectui `e5311165` (#12168/#12141, which reads `allowEnvironmentOverlay` only) is an ancestor of `088e0f705`, so the pin follows #22874 (seat note 6118044018). CI on `d4c22c8fe` was green across all shards, including all 6 `Test Core` shards.

**Checklist,** read on GitHub, not from the report:
- **PR form:** draft, base `main`; line 1 `Part of #15204`, line 2 `Clause-②: no`; the whole body is scanned and no closing keyword sits next to a card number; assignee `marchtian`.
- **Scope:** 9 files, +133/−52. `check-governed-merges --pr` reads NOT governed. No `CHANGELOG.md` and no `content/docs/releases/`.
- **The diff does exactly the ruled phase 2:**
  - `sys_user_position.position` declares `widget: 'position-ref'`.
  - `sys_user_permission_set.permission_set` declares `widget: 'permission-ref'`.
  - `permission_set_id` is `hidden: true`, and its column stays for C7b (the maintainer agreed to hide it).
  - The user page's two `add` blocks are deleted, and their comments are rewritten to say why.
- **`Clause-②: no` holds.** No `packages/spec` file is touched. `widget` is a free-string field hint (`FieldSchema.widget`), and `hidden` is an existing field key. The removed `add` blocks were page content, not an accepted-metadata set.
- **The changeset** `15204-grant-name-pickers.md`, patch for `platform-objects` and `plugin-security`. Each sentence was read against the diff:
  - the two widget declarations, and the stored name;
  - "a console without those widgets keeps the text input" (the record form degrades an unregistered hint to the type renderer, objectui#5254);
  - `permission_set_id` hidden, with its column staying;
  - the two buttons removed, because they listed rows a deployment need not hold;
  - grant with **New**;
  - "removing a grant is unchanged", which is phase 1's measurement in 6116396441 ("row-level **Remove survives** and works").
- **Evidence:**
  - Dogfood `grant-name-pickers` pins: the served `GET /meta/object` carries both hints and the `hidden` flag.
  - The page pin: no `add` on either list, with a business-unit control.
  - Ablations: stripping the hints turns the three served-metadata cases red; re-adding an `add` turns the page pin red.
  - Full suites: dogfood 253 files, plugin-security 197, platform-objects 69, cli unit green. The i18n parity floor went 45 → 44 because the two `add` labels left.
  - `dispatch-gates --ran`: 72 of 72 exit 0.
  - In the browser, against objectui PR-5's head: both fields render as registry pickers (16 positions, 17 sets), a pick wrote both rows, and the legacy-id field is gone.
- **CI on `7de0f00c91`:** 42 check-runs: 37 `success`, 5 skipped, 0 red. The five skips are all on `check-expected-skips`'s roster: `Build Docs`, `Console Pin Gate` (the net diff leaves `.objectui-sha` untouched), `Auto Label`, `Check PR Size` and `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)`. All six `Test Core` shards and their aggregate are `success`. `mergeable_state` is `clean`. The developer re-ran the derived gates on this head as well: 72 of 72 exit 0, `check:console-sha` included.

**Until the console pin moves**, the two fields render as text inputs for the name. The pin goes 4997995 → `e5311165` in #22874, then a follow-up hop to `088e0f705`. `main` is unreleased.

**Recorded finding, not filed here:** the position picker also lists `everyone`, the audience anchor, which the server refuses as a grant target. This is an objectui filter question; the seat routes it.

**Then:** flipped ready and enqueued in this same stroke. On MERGED, a Landed record. This PR and the pin PR together are D's (#22900) landing gate.
